query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'Stop basement leaks permanently. We fix wet basements in London Ontario with a written 20-year warranty, using interior drainage, sump pumps, weeping tile replacement, and crack injection.',
  longDesc = 'A wet basement is one of the most common and most damaging problems London homeowners face. The clay-heavy soil in this region expands when wet and contracts when dry, putting constant pressure on foundation walls. Add in aging weeping tile systems and the heavy spring snowmelt that hits Southwestern Ontario every year, and it is easy to see why basements in neighbourhoods like Old North, Byron, and Old South are especially vulnerable.\n\nWe start every job with a thorough inspection. We look at where water is entering, whether it is coming through cracks, through the floor, or through the wall-floor joint, and we check the condition of your weeping tile and sump system. From there we recommend the right fix for your specific situation, not a one-size-fits-all package.\n\nFor most London homes, interior drainage is the most practical solution. We install a perimeter drainage channel along the inside of the basement floor, connected to a high-capacity sump pump with a battery backup. This system collects water before it reaches the floor and removes it automatically, even during a power outage. For more serious cases, we excavate around the exterior of the foundation, apply a waterproof membrane, and replace the weeping tile from the outside.\n\nAll of our wet basement work is backed by a written 20-year warranty. If the repaired area develops a water problem within that period, we come back and fix it at no charge. The warranty is transferable if you sell the home.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"Written 20-Year Warranty","desc":"Our waterproofing work is backed in writing. If water returns to the repaired area within 20 years, we fix it at no charge, and the warranty transfers to new owners."},{"title":"Interior Drainage Systems","desc":"Perimeter drainage channels and sump pumps with battery backup remove water automatically, keeping your basement dry even during heavy storms and power outages."},{"title":"Exterior Waterproofing","desc":"For severe cases, we excavate around the foundation, apply a waterproof membrane, and replace aging weeping tile to stop water at the source."},{"title":"Crack Injection Repairs","desc":"Structural cracks in poured concrete walls are sealed with epoxy or polyurethane injection, stopping water entry at the point of failure."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Wet Basement Repair London ON | 20-Year Warranty | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Permanent wet basement waterproofing in London Ontario with a written 20-year warranty. Interior drainage, sump pumps, exterior excavation. 24/7 emergency. Call 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'wet-basement-repair';
